The lesson is written, but the second review pass still ended on `Verdict: revise`. Two passes was the limit, so I applied its cheap fixes and published. The lesson runs long, at about 5,500 words by my own estimate. That is inside the bench's range for 30 minutes. It is heavy against your "keep it short" preference, though. Parts 3, 4 and 5 each carry more than one worked trace. If it feels like too much, tell me and I'll make follow-ups shorter, with one example per part.

I haven't opened the lesson in a browser. The figure labels were checked by estimate only.

**What I wrote:**
- **Lesson:** `lessons/0001-context-and-memory.html`, objective O3, 30 minutes. It has six parts: token, context window, accumulation and compaction, retrieval, memory notes, and a context budget. It uses the makerspace assistant for every example and has six figures.
- **Quiz and key:** `quizzes/0002.json` has five fresh items, none of them repeating the lesson's practice questions. The key is `keys/0002.json`; I won't share answers, only hints.
- **Cheat sheet:** `cheatsheets/context-and-memory.html`.
- **Records:** `review-records/0001-lesson.md` covers both review passes. I added the five sources to `RESOURCES.md`, and noted the lesson in `NOTES.md`. There is no learning record yet, since you haven't shown anything on this topic.

All the makerspace sizes (the 48,000-token manual, the 1,015-token base) are made-up teaching numbers, and the lesson says so. The prices come from Anthropic's pricing page. I found no community for the "Wisdom" section, so none is named.

Want to take the quiz now? Your answers will be graded and your own wording read for the idea, not matched to a key.
